newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Volvo says U.S. car sales up 5.2 pct May.
newsitem.headline: Volvo says U.S. car sales up 5.2 pct May.

text.p: Swedish vehicle maker AB Volvo said on Monday its U.S. car sales rose 5.2 percent in May to 8,614 vehicles from the same month a year earlier.
During the first five months of the year, Volvo sold 39,559 cars in the U.S., compared to 39,522 cars in the same period last year, Volvo Car spokesman Ingmar Hesslefors told Reuters.
In Canada, Volvo sold 1,003 cars in May, up 52 percent from the same month last year, he said.
From January to May, Volvo's Canadian car sales rose to 3,863 vehicles from 3,208 during the corresponding period last year, Hesslefors said.
